searchText: You can jump forward by a large amount on Ethereum L1 (I know nothing about L2). On L1 everything would just work. so if I lock 20millions to be released by the first caller on my birthday, there might be an incentive for miner to accelerate to it? Yes. Timestamps on Ethereum under Proof of Work are manipulatable on short timescales. Meaning they may be off by a minute or two, but they will (over time) always end up approximately correct over larger timescales.
